constructionLineage.root: the pushed commit containing this authorization record

objective: v0.10 hub-hosted QR pairing landing page per RFC-0017: serve GET /auth on the hub authorities that can mint pairing URLs, add a narrow fail-closed exception to the global query fence for exactly GET /auth?token=<6 digits>, add an explicit https-only QR mint base override so minted URLs resolve on the operator-designated phone-reachable origin, and ship a zero-dependency landing page that verifies the code via the existing POST /hub/pairing/verify and scrubs the token from the address bar; no new credentials and no change to pairing engine semantics

must: RFC-first design record (RFC-0017) before product construction

landing page served at GET /auth on the selector-apex authority and the management (unrelated-host) authority, backed by one shared self-contained asset set with zero external network requests and a single dedicated asset root (no per-branch copies)

selector-apex allowlist grows by exactly two tuples: (GET, /auth) and (POST, /hub/pairing/verify) (plus existing trailing-slash variants), so the landing page reaches the unchanged verify handler; POST /hub/pairing/generate-code remains management-only and apex verify routing is pinned by matrix field A13
node-route authorities remain pure proxies: /auth is never intercepted there and no query-fence behavior changes on route authorities

query fence exception is one raw-query grammar: GET /auth whose raw query string matches ^token=[0-9]{6}$ byte-for-byte (no decoding, no parameter parsing); every other method/path/parameter combination keeps the existing fail-closed behavior, including HEAD/OPTIONS on /auth

QR mint base override env DSH_ORBIT_HUB_QR_PAIRING_BASE_URL: https-only, no query, no userinfo, validated in validateHubConfig with the collected-config clean-exit pattern; falls back to request-Host-derived base when unset; machine pairing env DSH_ORBIT_HUB_PAIRING_BASE_URL is not overloaded or repurposed
landing page POSTs the existing /hub/pairing/verify with same-origin fetch and maps existing failure codes (invalid-or-expired, rate-limited) to explicit UI states without inventing new endpoints

token hygiene: token scrubbed from the address bar via history.replaceState after read, never rendered back into the DOM as the code value, never written to server logs or audit records, Cache-Control: no-store and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer on every /auth response
post-success navigation targets only first-party constant paths on the same origin; no parameter-derived redirect targets

verification success reuses the existing operator-session bootstrap and its exact cookie attributes; no new credential types; no server-side changes to the verify handler including no new response headers (no Retry-After in v0.10)

deployment edge strategy recorded with the closure: on the public apex exactly GET /auth and POST /hub/pairing/verify are exempt from the operator's edge basic-auth gate; all other apex paths keep the gate; the exemption is a prerequisite of mounted field M1
mechanical test coverage for fence narrowness (parameter-boundary and encoding variants), mint base override, state mapping, and token-leak absence (audit store and response body scans)
candidate-freeze rule compliance and fresh candidate-bound evidence for the v0.10 release candidate
should: landing page visual language consistent with the RFC-0011 selector UI
lockout and attempt messaging surfaced from the existing pairing engine state (attempts remaining, retry-after)
single-file landing page asset (inline CSS/JS) to keep the new public asset surface minimal
outOfScope: wildcard node-route subdomains, public DNS records, Cloudflare certificate purchases, or any DNS cutover work (operator infrastructure decision, deferred)
changes to the pairing engine's crypto, TTL, single-use destruction, or lockout semantics (proven in v0.9)
changes to the node-side plugin QR fallback path
a new route authority system beyond RFC-0010
a new selector system beyond RFC-0011
weakening or removing the global query fence beyond the narrow /auth exception
exposing /hub/pairing/generate-code on the selector-apex authority (minting stays session-gated on the management surface)
server-side changes to the verify handler, including new response headers (Retry-After is explicitly out of scope for v0.10)
serving the landing page from duplicated per-branch asset copies instead of one shared root
virtual loopback manipulation or rewriting external request Host/Origin/remoteAddress to 127.0.0.1
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

allowedPathRules: package.json: dependency changes require recorded justification
forbiddenActions: reopening or rewriting the accepted v0.9 closure lineage or its attestation
product construction before RFC-0017 and Stage 0 Gate A approval is recorded
overloading the machine pairing env DSH_ORBIT_HUB_PAIRING_BASE_URL for QR minting
changing the DSH baseline outside the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

evidenceRequirements.candidateFreezeRule: exactly one frozen candidate per evidence round; once frozen, later phases produce only qualification/evidence; a real problem means a new candidate and fresh candidate-bound evidence
evidenceRequirements.landingMatrixRequired: a dedicated acceptance matrix defined in RFC-0017 (M17: 13 automated + 4 mounted fields) must be mechanically enforced via scripts/v10-landing-acceptance-matrix.mjs and a governance-contract test before the v0.10 mounted evidence run
evidenceRequirements.closureRule: one evidence-only closure, direct child of the frozen candidate, attestation must not reference its own closure SHA
